first_reader_said: EZR 2:7: Both records hold Elam whose 1,254 descendants returned in this list.
NEH 7:12: Both records are the ancestor of the 1,254 'children of Elam' in the return list (EZR 2:7 = NEH 7:12).

why: Both records identify the ancestor of the same 1,254 returning descendants in EZR 2:7 and NEH 7:12; B is a thinner duplicate with no distinguishing genealogy. A supplies further descendant connections in EZR 8:7, EZR 10:2, and EZR 10:26. The chief in NEH 10:14 and singer in NEH 12:42 are not securely identified with that ancestor merely by name, but neither establishes a separate identity for B.
